layer.description: The output node's layer to write, one file per frame.

frames.description: Number of frames (2..=10000), spread evenly from `from` to `to` inclusive.

dir.description: Output directory; relative paths resolve against the project's `exports/`. Files are `<layer>_<frame>.<ext>`.

flip_y.description: Flip rows so row 0 is north (image convention). Default true for images, false for RAW.

range_m.description: Height range mapped to [0, 65535] for quantised formats; defaults to the field's min/max.

georeference.description:
For `tiff32`: write GeoTIFF tags (pixel scale, tie point, EPSG GeoKeys) when the caller
supplies a [`GeoRef`]. Default true; the file is then always north-up.

oneOf.description: OpenEXR, single `Y` channel, 32-bit float, lossless (ZIP). Exact.
16-bit grayscale PNG, normalised to the export range.
Headerless little-endian u16, normalised to the export range (Unity / Unreal).
TIFF, single 32-bit float sample per pixel (GIS and DCC tools read it directly). Exact.
